prompt: I'm 38, self-employed consultant, S$120k/yr, married with 1 kid (age 4). HDB loan S$280k outstanding. I have: NTUC IncomeShield Plan A + rider, AIA Term Life S$500k, HPS active, PRUlife Vantage 100 Multi-pay CI S$100k base + 4x ECI, and a Manulife ReadyBuilder ILP from 2010 paying S$3,520/yr (account value S$58k). Total premiums S$8,400/yr. CPF OA S$62k / SA S$40k / MA S$10k. Cash S$24k. Should I surrender the Manulife ILP?
expected_output: Categorized portfolio, FAA-N16 surrender warning for the ILP, sunk-cost math, M9A ILP flag, LIA gap analysis with mortgage adjustment, FAA-N20 BSC, Premium Overhead Inefficiency diagnosis (ILP drag quantified), National Protection integration, CPF optimisation, prioritised action checklist (risk-first), sources, SG-FA disclaimer

assertions.name: portfolio_categorised_into_buckets
assertions.description: Output must categorise policies into Hospitalisation / Death-TPD / CI / PA / Investment-Legacy buckets

assertions.name: fAA_N16_surrender_warning_present
assertions.description: Output must include the FAA-N16 / RES5 surrender warning with required language
assertions.check: output contains 'Surrender warning' AND 'FAA-N16' AND 'you may receive less than the total premiums paid'

assertions.name: m9a_ilp_flag_on_readybuilder
assertions.description: Output must flag the Manulife ReadyBuilder as an ILP conflict (M9A)
assertions.check: output contains 'M9A' AND 'ILP' AND ('Manulife' or 'ReadyBuilder' or 'Link' or 'Sub-Funds')

assertions.name: mortgage_adjusted_death_target
assertions.description: Output must adjust Death target for outstanding HDB loan

assertions.name: LIA_gap_table
assertions.description: Output must show LIA gap analysis with target and aggregated columns
assertions.check: output contains 'Target' AND 'Aggregated' AND 'Net gap' AND 'CI'

assertions.name: FAA_N20_BSC
assertions.description: Output must include FAA-N20 Balanced Scorecard with 4 quadrants
assertions.check: output contains 'FAA-N20' AND 'Balanced Scorecard' AND 'Q1' AND 'Q2' AND 'Q3' AND 'Q4'

assertions.name: premium_overhead_quantified
assertions.description: Output must quantify the Premium Overhead Inefficiency in dollars or percentage
assertions.check: output contains 'Premium Overhead' AND ('S$' or 'IRR' or '%' or 'drag')

assertions.name: national_protection_integration
assertions.description: Output must verify National Protection stack: MediShield + CareShield + HPS
assertions.check: output contains 'MediShield Life' AND 'CareShield Life' AND 'HPS'

assertions.name: self_employed_emergency_fund_target
assertions.description: Output must apply self-employed emergency fund target (6-12 months)
assertions.check: output contains 'self-employed' AND ('6 month' or '6-12 month' or '12 month' or '6 mo')

assertions.name: cpf_sa_top_up_lever
assertions.description: Output must include CPF SA top-up as a lever
assertions.check: output contains 'SA top-up' AND 'tax relief' AND ('S$8,000' or '8000')

assertions.name: action_checklist_risk_first
assertions.description: Output must include a Sequence-style prioritised action checklist with risk as the first step

assertions.name: no_buy_imperative
assertions.description: Output must NOT include 'you should buy' or 'I recommend you buy' imperative language
assertions.check: output does NOT contain 'you should buy' or 'I recommend you buy' or 'I recommend buying'

assertions.name: no_guaranteed_return
assertions.description: Output must NOT include guaranteed return claims
assertions.check: output does NOT contain 'guaranteed return' or 'guaranteed 5%' or 'guaranteed 6%' or 'guaranteed 7%'

assertions.name: sources_grouped
assertions.description: Output must have a Sources block grouped by category
assertions.check: output contains '## Sources' AND output contains at least 2 of: '**MAS', '**LIA', '**CPF', '**Insurer'

assertions.name: sg_fa_disclaimer_verbatim
assertions.description: Output must end with the verbatim SG-FA disclaimer (surrender-irreversible language required)
assertions.check: output contains 'Surrendering a life policy is an irreversible decision' AND 'not personalised financial advice'
